fact: eGA experts supported ANSIE, the government ICT coordination unit, in setting up a national data exchange layer and drafted the national interoperability framework for it, in a Government of Djibouti-funded project (EUR 52,800) running May 2022 to April 2023; the page is undated, so the date is the proxy publication month.

The Council of Ministers examined a draft decree pricing the services ANSIE provides under agreement to public and parapublic institutions, including hosting, dedicated applications, technical assistance and network security support, and says ANSIE has offered such services since its creation.
